messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — planning a rolling reboot of az5 GPU pools this Sat 03:00-07:00 UTC to deploy NIC firmware + pv-bmc microcode. Soft drains in 15-min cohorts.
eli: Which pools? Hosted vs Dedicated? Tenant impact?
samir: Targets: pool-gpu-az5-general and pool-gpu-az5-interruptible. Dedicated excluded unless customer opts in.
lina: APAC maps to evening — avoid 03:30-04:30 UTC if possible.
maria.g: Good call. We'll shift the hottest cohort away from 03:30-04:30. Cohorts: 03:00-03:15 A (canary), 03:20-03:35 B, 03:45-04:00 C, etc. 10-15m buffer between cohorts for KV cache warmup/prefix seeding.
eli: Hedging plan? Can we pre-warm eu-west racks to absorb traffic?
samir: Proposed hedges: spin up 4 standby GPUs in eu-west1 (burst pool), route latency-sensitive hosted customers to eu-west via routing policy, and enable small-model fallback (quantized-llm-v2-8bit) for background batch jobs.
kai: Cost note — spinning 4 nodes for ~4h ~= $X (will post calc). Cheaper: preemptible warmbackfill?
samir: Mix approach: 2 reserved warm nodes + 2 preemptible. Preemptible OK for non-SLA tenants; avoid for latency-critical flows.
ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MNT-4319 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MNT-4319). Runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/maintenance/MNT-4319.
lina: Can we canary one rack first? Last NIC reboot caused ~90s packet drop once.
maria.g: Yes — step 0 is canary rack at 03:00 for cohort A. Abort if packet drops >2% in 5m.
eli: KV cache seeding: if we drain many prefix homes latency spikes. Need `kvseed` before routing.
samir: Add prewarm job in runbook: `./tools/kvseed --pool pool-gpu-az5-general --concurrency 8 --ttl 3600`. Wait 8-12m after node joins before sending traffic.
kai: I'll add cost/impact blurb for ops-announce for SRE & finance.
maria.g: Comm plan: ops-announce T-48h, channel ping T-2h, status updates per cohort, post-mortem in #postmortems. Blockers?
eli: Ensure Dedicated customers with reserved capacity get explicit email (not only slack). Provide opt-out window 48h.
maria.g: Will trigger enterprise comms flow.
lina: Oncall checklist snippet:
```
- create MNT ticket
- canary rack reboot
- monitor egress packet drops
- run kvseed on rejoined nodes
- confirm prefix-cache hit-rate >= 90% before routing
- post cohort status
```
samir: Also add step: toggle routing fallback to quantized-llm-v2-8bit for background batch routes if tail latency >200ms.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Maintenance MNT-4319 will start Sat 03:00 UTC.
maria.g: Thanks all — I'll circulate updated timeline and the cost estimate. If no objections by EOD we'll lock schedule. :thumbsup:
